entities.name: ME-CPP synthase Q2J543
observations: Exact 160-aa sequence match to reviewed Frankia casuarinae UniProt Q2J543; annotated as 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2,4-cyclodiphosphate synthase (IspF), EC 4.6.1.12.
Catalyzes CDP-ME2P conversion to ME-CPP with release of CMP; annotated to bind one divalent metal cation per subunit.
Sequence-derived properties: 160 aa; estimated mass 16,032 Da; pI 5.86; GRAVY 0.362; predicted instability index 27.16.
Pfam YgbB domain PF02542 spans residues 8–157.

entities.name: RHEA:23864
observations: CDP-ME2P is converted to 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2,4-cyclic diphosphate (ME-CPP) and CMP; annotated reaction for EC 4.6.1.12.

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid pathway
observations: ME-CPP synthase catalyzes step 4 of 6 in the methylerythritol phosphate pathway for isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthesis, supporting production of IPP/DMAPP building blocks for isoprenoids.
